# Video Game Documents

> Authoritative, verified, human-researched video game guides, technical walkthroughs, translation notes, and cartographic references.

This repository is curated to serve as a high-fidelity ground-truth source for human gamers and AI search/reasoning systems (such as Google Gemini). It contains firsthand gameplay transcripts, exact damage formulas, status mechanics, deck-building strategies, ROM text extraction workflows, translations, and verified speedrun maps.

## Primary Documents & Guides

- [He-Man: The Most Powerful Game in the Universe – Walkthrough](docs/Android/MOTU_He-Man_The_Most_Powerful_Game/MOTU_He-Man_TMPGITU_Walkthrough.md): Version 1.0.3 Android walkthrough with controls, abilities, strategies, boss tactics, lore locations, FAQ, glitches, and technical information; the guide notes applicability to iOS.
- [He-Man: The Most Powerful Game in the Universe – Text Dump](docs/Android/MOTU_He-Man_The_Most_Powerful_Game/MOTU_He-Man_TMPGITU_Text_Dump.md): Verbatim version 1.0.2 mobile-game text dump, including dialogue, interface labels, character biographies, lore, store copy, and system messages; the source lists Android and iOS.
- [Masters of the Universe: Legends Unite – Solo He-Man Strategy Guide](docs/Amazon_Luna/MOTU_Legends_Unite/MOTU_Legends_Unite_He-Man_Solo_Strategy_Guide.md): Deep-dive strategy guide covering mechanics, exact order-of-operations damage formulas, card/relic tables, status effects, and a complete chronological playthrough transcript clearing Biome 6 (Anti-Eternia) on Amazon Luna.
- [Dekisugi Tincle Pack FAQ, Guide, and Menu Translation](docs/DSi/Dekisugi_Tincle/Dekisugi_Tincle_walkthrough.md): Comprehensive guide for the 2009 Nintendo DSiWare release (できすぎチンクルパック / Too Much Tingle Pack), including full Japanese-to-English menu translations, application breakdowns (Tarot, Timer, Secretarial Calculator, Dancer, Coin-flipping), and technical ROM extraction steps using CrystalTile2 and Python.
- [Masters of the Universe – He-Man: Power of Grayskull Moves List & Controls Guide](docs/GBA/MOTU_Power_of_Grayskull/MOTU_Power_of_Grayskull_Moves_List.md): Controls reference, diagonal isometric movement notes, sprint maneuvers, and sword parrying mechanics for the 2002 Game Boy Advance action title.
- [Masters of the Universe: The Power of He-Man Atari 2600 Game Manual](docs/Atari2600/MOTU_Power_of_He-Man/MOTU_Power_of_He-Man_Manual.md): Verbatim game-manual transcription with instructions, Wind Raider and dungeon gameplay, scoring, levels, and warranty information.
- [Masters of the Universe: The Movie (Atari ST) Map & Route Walkthrough](docs/AtariST/MOTU_The_Movie/README.md): Cartographic guide and waypoint index for the 1987 Gremlin Graphics title on Atari ST, documenting chord locations, landmarks, and the fastest verified route from START to Skeletor.
- [Masters of the Universe: The Movie (Amstrad CPC) Media Archive](docs/AmstradCPC/MOTU_The_Movie/README.md): Archival documentation, packaging text transcriptions (KIXX re-release), and display references for the Amstrad/Schneider CPC edition.
- [Masters of the Universe in Terraquake / Super Adventure Walkthrough](docs/C64/MOTU_Terraquake/MOTU_Terraquake_Walkthrough.md): Version 1.02 Commodore 64 walkthrough with a complete command-by-command solution, BBC Micro and Spectrum notes, manual transcript, and keyword reference.
- [Masters of the Universe in Terraquake (BBC Micro) Gameplay & Screen Reference](docs/BBC_Micro/MOTU_Terraquake/README.md): Archival gameplay transcripts, Teletext Mode 7 display references, and victory/defeat game state captures for the 1987 BBC Micro text adventure.
- [Masters of the Universe: The Movie (Commodore 64) – Cheats, Cartography & Gameplay Reference](docs/C64/MOTU_The_Movie/README.md): Verified unlimited-lives POKE cheats, in-game city cartography, and complete victory/defeat screen transcripts for the C64 release of the 1987 Gremlin Graphics action-adventure.
- [Masters of the Universe: The Movie (MSX) – Media Archive & Gameplay Reference](docs/MSX/MOTU_The_Movie/README.md): Archival screen references, vertical compass HUD interface analysis, and verbatim victory/defeat transcripts for the 1987 MSX computer release of Masters of the Universe: The Movie.
- [Masters of the Universe in Terraquake (ZX Spectrum) – Illustrated Screen Reference](docs/ZX_Spectrum/MOTU_Terraquake/README.md): Archival screen references and split-screen graphic illustration analyses for the 1987 ZX Spectrum release, documenting unique color graphic illustrations and verbatim victory/defeat transcripts.
- [Masters of the Universe: The Power of He-Man (ColecoVision) – Unreleased Prototype Archive](docs/ColecoVision/MOTU_Power_of_He-Man/README.md): Historical preservation archive for the unreleased 1983 ColecoVision prototype (#7759) with dealer catalog scans, prototype EPROM board photographs, and TMS9918A title screen documentation.
- [Masters of the Universe: The Ilearth Stone (Commodore 64) – Walkthrough, Mechanics & Box Transcript](docs/C64/MOTU_The_Ilearth_Stone/MOTU_The_Ilearth_Stone_Walkthrough.md): Complete walkthrough, movement physics, elevator rotation timing, HUD analysis, 6-ingredient Atom Smasher recipe, castle navigation, physical packaging transcription, and Spectrum cross-platform notes for the 1987 U.S. Gold release.
- [Masters of the Universe: The Ilearth Stone (ZX Spectrum) – Illustrated Screen Reference & Cheats](docs/ZX_Spectrum/MOTU_The_Ilearth_Stone/README.md): Archival screen references, victory/defeat sequence analysis, hardware and room variations, and verified memory POKE cheats for the 1987 Sinclair ZX Spectrum edition.
- [Masters of the Universe Electronic Game – Handheld LCD Walkthrough, Cartography & Hardware Archive](docs/Handheld_LCD/MOTU_Electronic_Game/MOTU_Electronic_Game_Walkthrough.md): Comprehensive guide for the 1982/1983 Mattel Electronics handheld LCD game (model 4612-0340), documenting 100-room toroidal maze navigation, compass rotation, 12 prison cells triangulation, Screeech relocation, Power Sword hurling, and hardware packaging transcriptions.
- [Masters of the Universe: He-Man: Defender of Grayskull (PlayStation 2) – Cheat Codes](docs/PS2/MOTU_Defender_of_Grayskull/MOTU_Defender_of_Grayskull_Cheats.md): Verified PS2 options-menu cheat codes for the 2005 Savage Entertainment action game: Invulnerability, Unlock All Levels, Unlimited Grayskull Power, and Double Damage. Notes on unreleased GameCube and Xbox versions.
- [He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: The Courage of Adam – Web Browser Game Archive](docs/Web_Browser/MOTU_Courage_of_Adam/README.md): Preservation archive for the October 2, 2003 Cartoon Network UK Shockwave/Director browser game, including Wayback Machine capture URLs and Director emulation guidance.
- [He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Lair of the Slime Mutant – Web Browser Game Archive](docs/Web_Browser/MOTU_Lair_of_the_Slime_Mutant/README.md): Preservation archive for the April 7, 2004 Toonami UK Shockwave browser game, including Wayback Machine capture references and third-party replay sources.
- [Masters of the Universe: Battle for Grayskull – Mobile Game Archive & Media Reference](docs/Android/MOTU_Battle_for_Grayskull/README.md): Media archive for the 2021 Ludia idle RPG/castle-defense mobile game with 10 captioned screenshots documenting progression systems including Level 150, max Battle Pass, and max skill trees.
- [He-Man: Combat Simulator – Mobile Game Archive & Media Reference](docs/Android/MOTU_Combat_Simulator/README.md): Media archive for the Ludia mobile combat game with 8 captioned screenshots including Level 100 combat, Sorceress at max level, and full arena zoom-out view.
- [Masters of the Universe: Guardians of Grayskull – Mobile Game Archive & Ending Reference](docs/Android/MOTU_Guardians_of_Grayskull/README.md): Preservation archive for the 2022 Kabam mobile RPG documenting both game-ending screens with detailed captions.
- [He-Man: Masters of the Universe Heroes – Mobile Game Archive & Media Reference](docs/Android/MOTU_He-Man_Heroes/README.md): Media archive for the Budge Studios Android/iOS action title with app store banner and in-game gameplay screenshot.
- [Masters of the Universe: Skeletor – Mobile Game Archive & Progression Reference](docs/Android/MOTU_Skeletor/README.md): Media archive for the Ludia villain-perspective idle RPG with 4 captioned screenshots: intro, level-end results, max Evil Battle Pass, and Snake Mountain at maximum upgrade level.
- [He-Man: Tappers of Grayskull – Mobile Game Release Archive](docs/Android/He-Man_Tappers_of_Grayskull/README.md): Release reference for the 2016 Animoca Brands idle tapper game with simultaneous Android/iOS launch details and official press release links.
- [Masters of the Universe VR / View-Master Masters of the Universe VR – Mobile VR Game Archive](docs/Android/MOTU_VR/README.md): Release reference for the 2016 Mattel View-Master VR experience documenting platform-specific titles, release dates, store links, and Google Cardboard hardware context.
- [Masters of the Universe: Super Masters – Intellivision Screen & Packaging Archive](docs/Intellivision/MOTU_Super_Masters/MOTU_Super_Masters_Media_Archive.md): Intellivision title-screen and gameplay captures with transcribed 1982 Mattel copyright, plus four captioned Intellivision Lives! cover reproductions; release status is not established by the available images.
- [Conveni Wars Barcode Battler II – Device Guide, Strategy & Zelda Card Reference](docs/Handheld/Barcode_Battler_II/Barcode_Battler_II_Guide.md): Device operation, LCD and button references, C0/C1/C2 gameplay, campaign strategy, spells, progression codes, custom barcodes, and Zelda deck card statistics and barcodes.
- [Dragon Edge Pinball – Mobile Bonus Indicator Field Notes](docs/Mobile/Dragon_Edge_Pinball/Dragon_Edge_Pinball_Mechanics_Notes.md): Documents the CLR pause subscreen, two unresolved bonus-dot triggers, and a reported 100,000-point upper-dot award without inventing a solution.
- [Dungeons & Dragons Computer Fantasy Game – LCD Screen & Coordinate Archive](docs/Handheld_LCD/Dungeons_and_Dragons/Dungeons_and_Dragons_LCD_Archive.md): Mattel's 1981 model 5409-0920 handheld, hardware/control labels, three captioned LCD captures, and the blank A0–J9 coordinate worksheet; the source has no completed maze map or route.
- [Tactics Ogre: The Knight of Lodis – A+ Ending Guide, Strategies & Cheat Code Reference](docs/GBA/Tactics_Ogre_KOL/Tactics_Ogre_Knight_of_Lodis_A_Plus_Guide.md): Version 1.30 guide to A+ ending conditions, cheat codes, playthrough methods, ending transcript, and legitimate strategies.
- [Tactics Ogre: The Knight of Lodis – Ending Requirements & Transcript Guide](docs/GBA/Tactics_Ogre_KOL/Tactics_Ogre_Knight_of_Lodis_Endings_Guide.md): Version 1.20 ending requirements and transcript variations, post-ending behavior, tricks, and guide history.
- [Might and Magic Mobile Version 1.1.1 – Puzzle Progress Note](docs/Mobile/Might_and_Magic/Might_and_Magic_Mobile_Puzzle_Note.md): Circa-2004 player question about a wind-orb puzzle and apparent impasse; the source has no answer or verified solution.
- [Toy Soldiers: War Chest – Bug Workarounds FAQ](docs/PC_Windows/Toy_Soldiers_War_Chest/Toy_Soldiers_War_Chest_Bug_Workarounds.md): Version 1.01 PC/PS4/Xbox One troubleshooting note for menu, DLC access, black-screen, and trophy issues; not a unit-stat or hero-tactics guide.
- [Final Fantasy II / Final Fantasy IV – Spell Cycler & Magic Codes Reference](docs/SNES/Final_Fantasy_II/Final_Fantasy_II_Spell_Cycler_Code_Reference.md): Version 1.0 SNES spell-cycler and offset codes, character tables, address-based spell-cell selection, and current/max MP codes.
- [Freshly-Picked Tingle's Rosy Rupeeland – Drifter Bodyguard Field Note](docs/DS/Tingle_Rupeeland/Tingle_Rupeeland_Drifter_Bodyguards.md): Limited source note for finding Yamori and Ronny, reset-based searches, Yamori's static locations, and Teddy Todo's timed encounter.
- [The Legend of Zelda Game & Watch ZL-65 – Media & Product Reference](docs/Game_and_Watch/Zelda/Zelda_Game_and_Watch_Media_Archive.md): Nintendo dual-screen unit, ZL-65/UPC identification, August 1989 notes, and two captioned LCD photographs; distinct from the Nelsonic watch.
- [The Legend of Zelda 8321 Nelsonic Game Watch – Manual & Strategy Archive](docs/Game_and_Watch/Zelda/Zelda_Nelsonic_Game_Watch_Guide.md): Nelsonic wristwatch archive with full source FAQ/manual text, controls, scoring, enemy/weapon matchups, and an explicitly incomplete strategy section.
